messages:
olivia: Anyone else seeing a spike in 5xx from az-west2 GPUs? latency and errors up ~30% since 11:05 UTC
infra-bot: [ALERT] gateway-lb-az-west2 HTTP 5xx rate high (sustained 6m) :rotating_light:
oncall-az-west2: paging on-call for az-west2
sanjay: Confirmed. traceroute to 13.92.45.10 (azure-peering) stops at 3 hops, then * * *. Looks like a peering blackhole between our transit hub and azure edge.
mike: Seeing GPU pool drain in az-west2 — a few nodes got networkEvicted, jobs rescheduled. Node events: 
```
Warning  Eviction  1m kubelet: eviction due to network-unavailable
```
leah: Can we move traffic off az-west2 to eu-north and ord3? We have spare dedicated capacity there. What's the fastest route?
olivia: Short plan: 1) shift 50% of inference traffic to eu-north with weighted routing 2) scale dedicated pools in eu-north by +6 GPUs 3) open support case with Azure for peering blackhole and request BGP reset/validation.
sanjay: I'm already on the support chat. Case #AZ-998271 opened, they acknowledge anomalies on the peering fabric and are investigating. Estimated ETA unknown. They asked us to reroute as workaround.
mike: Executing safe drains on the worst nodes and marking remaining nodes un-schedulable in az-west2: 
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-45
kubectl drain gpu-node-45 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
Doing this gradually to avoid mass reschedules.
leah: Scaling eu-north reserved pool now. Running infra tooling: 
```
infractl scale-pool --region eu-north --pool gpu-dedicated --add 6
```
Should come up in ~7m. Also enabling burst capacity in ord3 by +4.
olivia: Routing change: updating global-routes weight for az-west2 from 1.0 -> 0.5 and eu-north 0.3 ord3 0.2. Applying in consul/traffic-router.
deploy-bot: route-update: global-routes changed weights {az-west2:0.5, eu-north:0.3, ord3:0.2} by olivia at 1860003462
mike: After weight change, errors dropped to ~8% and latency trending down. Some residual TCP resets from sessions pinned to failing frontends.
sanjay: Azure support responded: "We see intermittent blackholing on peering VLAN X between our edge and your transit. Engineering is performing path validation. Recommend advertising via alternate transit and enabling HA peer." They've provided a temporary AS-path to test.
olivia: Agreed to advertise prefixes through backup transit (transit-b) and enable HA peering. Sanjay, can you coordinate with netops to flip advertisement?
sanjay: Kicking it now. Running: 
```
netopsctl advertise-prefix --peer transit-b --prefix 203.0.113.0/24 --as-path-prepend none
```
I'll monitor BGP and traceroute.
oncall-az-west2: Noting increased billing risk: moving 40% traffic to other regions will use on-demand; finance estimate ~+$8k/day if sustained.
leah: We can limit surge by enabling request-level caching for common prompts and turning on KV cache TTL to 30s for low-sensitivity traffic. That should shave tokens and keep costs lower.
mike: Also toggled graceful-fallback policy so long-running sessions will failover to eu-north only after short reconnect, to avoid double-execution.
infra-bot: incident-update at 1860003660: mitigation in progress. Errors down from 30% -> 6%. GPU pool drain rate reduced.
sanjay: BGP via transit-b is propagating. traceroute now reaches azure edge with proper AS-path. Azure engineering says they're still validating physical spares but our workaround is holding.
olivia: Current status: 1) Traffic partially shifted (weights applied) 2) EU/ORD pools scaled +10 GPUs total 3) Support case open with Azure (AZ-998271) 4) Cost hit acknowledged by finance. Keeping on-call and SRE watch.
mike: Can someone add a synthetic test for peering health to alert earlier? I can push a small job to run traceroute+http healthcheck every 30s from our external probes.
leah: I'll own postmortem and follow-ups: follow-up items: BGP HA design, add transit-b as standard failover, automated reroute runbook, cost guardrails for cross-region shifts.
olivia: Good. Status will be "mitigated" once errors <3% and node drain fully stabilized. For now, monitoring and escalation path is set.
oncall-az-west2: Mitigation check at 1860003960: errors ~2.1%, GPU pools stable, no new evictions in 12m. Keeping the route weights in place for +2 hours.
olivia: Thanks everyone. Postmortem template: please add timelines and exact commands we ran. We'll sync in the 14:30 post-incident review. :white_check_mark:
